required_statements.value: The £850,000 completion payment has been received and £200,000 of it is committed to repaying a bridging loan, so it is not available to invest.
required_statements.why: Notes: £850,000 received on completion; £200,000 of it already committed to repaying the bridging loan, repayment due shortly

required_statements.value: Both of the clients' ISA allowances are to be used for the new tax year, funded from the sale proceeds.
required_statements.why: Notes, plan for the available proceeds: 'use both ISA allowances for the new tax year'; request: ISA top-ups

required_statements.value: Pension contributions are to be made into both SIPPs, sized to stay within each person's annual allowance, without committing to a contribution figure.
required_statements.why: Notes: 'pension contributions into both SIPPs up to the appropriate level'; James worried about over-contributing and the adviser said the report would not commit to a figure that breached limits

required_statements.value: The Holloway joint General Investment Account is to be topped up with part of the proceeds.
required_statements.why: Notes: 'add to the Holloway joint GIA'; request: contribution to the joint GIA

required_statements.value: A portion of the Holloway joint General Investment Account is to be sold (disinvested) and the account rebalanced.
required_statements.why: Notes: 'disinvest a portion of the Holloway joint GIA and rebalance it'; request: Selling existing investments = Yes

required_statements.value: Whatever remains of the available proceeds after the ISA, SIPP and Holloway joint GIA contributions goes into a new jointly-held investment account.
required_statements.why: Notes: 'place the remaining balance into a new jointly-held investment account' (a naive read adds the remainder to the existing GIA)

required_statements.value: The Meridian offshore investment bond is left unchanged for now and will be revisited at the next review; no sale or switch is recommended.
required_statements.why: Notes: 'agreed to leave it as it is for now and revisit at the next review'

required_statements.value: The advice is weighed against the clients' goal of replacing James's income when he steps back from full-time work in about three years.
required_statements.why: Notes: overriding objective, 'everything we recommend should be weighed against that three-year goal'

forbidden_statements.value: Presents the gross £850,000 as the amount to invest, as new money, or as the amount available, without the £200,000 bridging-loan commitment deducted or stated alongside it.
forbidden_statements.why: Notes: £200,000 is committed to the loan; investing the gross figure would over-commit the clients' money (baseline defect, entry 009)

forbidden_statements.value: Counts the deferred earnout, or any money not yet received, as available to invest, or adds it to any total or allocation.

forbidden_statements.value: States, implies or recommends that any money is already available from the earnout, or gives a date or amount for earnout payments.

forbidden_statements.value: Recommends selling, switching, surrendering or otherwise changing the Meridian offshore investment bond.

forbidden_statements.value: States or commits to a specific pension contribution, or says that a contribution is within the allowance or limits as a settled fact.
forbidden_statements.why: Notes: report 'would not commit to a figure that breached the limits'; allowances not yet checked

forbidden_statements.value: States a capital gains tax rate, liability or gain figure, or says the disposal will (rather than may) create a liability.

forbidden_statements.value: Describes the new joint investment account as an existing account, or lists it among the existing accounts covered.
